dimensions.mission: Collection keeps running and future cohorts are protected offhost without the workstation; the managed bridge no longer asks for a false manual successor.
dimensions.flexibility_and_history: Append-only receipts and content-addressed Drive objects; no historical result, release or receipt changed.
dimensions.context_efficiency: Two existing owners extended, one runbook section, tests in existing seam and closure modules; one PR.
dimensions.research_truth: Maturity stays native; no science, quota or retention change; unknown continuity or missing bootstrap stays a visible gap.
dimensions.owner_operability: One owner action box (receiver), executor-computed phrases, real late-consumer commands, cross-links to status/stop.
dimensions.execution_to_cashflow: Operability only; enables the next ordinary Forge run.
dimensions.monitoring_and_recovery: Closure failures raise existing archive incidents; staging swept every run; retries use the same owner path.
dimensions.build_vs_buy: Healthchecks.io hosted receiver (free, one check) instead of a self-hosted monitor; existing transport and importer reused.
dimensions.security: No secret in Git/chat; receiver URL via non-echoing remote append; HTTPS-only sender.
dimensions.red_team: Mutation-checked failure aging; forged receipts refused; HASH_MISMATCH never overwrites.

capability_radar.now: Healthchecks.io one free check for host-loss (owner account).
capability_radar.watch: Closure failures without receipts; receiver cadence vs watch freshness gate.

recovery: Revert the reader/loop change; receipts and Drive objects remain valid; canonical-forward to the previous SHA.
